scope: Frozen completion/git candidate plus round2 exact replacements; temporary repositories and mock remotes only.

findings.evidence: _snapshot enumerates tracked/untracked names, rejects filter attributes, then calls status and diff; regression asserts check-attr precedes status and configure rejects the filter fixture without marker execution.
PR publish checks canonical current repository root and symbolic branch against the reviewed token before remote snapshot/publish.
PR publish rechecks remote head and base OIDs against the reviewed local OIDs before invoking gh; mismatch test proves ghCalls remains zero.
Index mode checks reject 120000/160000 and unsupported patch markers reject symlink/gitlink mode changes; selected symlink paths are rejected.

Git/SSH environment redirection is scrubbed; AVEN_GIT_PATH and AVEN_GH_PATH are ignored unless trusted host options inject executables; PR review rejects core SSH/proxy, scoped HTTP proxy/TLS/header, URL rewrite, upload-pack and receive-pack settings before remote probing.
Review/apply/commit payloads bind the SHA-256 of raw index bytes in addition to full worktree and staged patch digests.
Snapshot rejects both worktree and staged patches above the 2 MiB review limit, matching the request body/output bound.
CAS/update-ref uncertainty includes state, commitOid, orphanObject and retry=false; UI preserves HTTP metadata and reports unknown with no created claim or automatic retry.
Configure clears patch/commit/PR review state, hides panels, clears selections, and invalidates in-flight refresh sequence before applying the new repository.
